primary_goal: Get visitors to purchase the Samsung 55-inch TV by clicking 'In den Warenkorb' or adding recommended bundles/financing.

friction_points.issue: Delivery cost is hidden in the hero section and only revealed further down the page.
friction_points.evidence: Hero price section states '449,- € inkl. MwSt. zzgl. Versand' without amount, while screenshot 3 shows '+ 39,90 €' under 'Lieferung nach Hause'.

friction_points.issue: Contradictory financing information between top notification bar and financing widget.
friction_points.evidence: Top black banner advertises '0% Finanzierung', but the financing card in screenshot 2 displays 'eff. Zins p.a. 10.90%** 27,04 € monatlich'.

friction_points.issue: Duplicate bundle recommendations create repetitive scrolling and high cognitive load on mobile.
friction_points.evidence: Screenshot 3-4 shows 'Gemeinsam günstiger' bundle for €518, while screenshot 10-12 shows almost identical 'Empfohlene Kombinationen' sections with repetitive add-to-cart CTAs.

friction_points.issue: Excessive legal footnote text takes up over 50% of total mobile scroll height.
friction_points.evidence: Screenshots 14 through 25 contain dense, unformatted legal disclaimers and asterisks taking up more than 10 mobile screen heights.

friction_points.issue: Customer ratings lack visible qualitative review highlights above the fold.
friction_points.evidence: Only star average '4.8 | (69 Bewertungen)' is shown as small text under the title in screenshot 1, without review quotes or breakdown.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we display the exact freight delivery fee (+ 39,90 €) or free store pickup option directly in the main price hero block, then add-to-cart rate will improve because unexpected delivery fee surprises at checkout are reduced.
hypotheses.change: Add 'zzgl. 39,90 € Speditionslieferung oder kostenlose Marktabholung' directly under the main €449 price in the hero section.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we explicitly show how to qualify for '0% Finanzierung' inside the financing calculator box, then financing conversion will increase because users will not perceive the 10.90% interest rate as misleading.
hypotheses.change: Update financing box to highlight '0% für 10 Monate (0,00 € Zinsen)' next to the standard 10.90% option.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we collapse repetitive bundle sections into a single consolidated 'Häufig zusammen gekauft' recommendation widget, then user scroll depth and primary TV conversion will improve because visual fatigue is reduced.
hypotheses.change: Merge 'Gemeinsam günstiger' and 'Empfohlene Kombinationen' into one single swipeable carousel widget.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we place footer legal footnotes into expandable accordion menus, then mobile usability will improve because users can reach footer navigation and trust links faster.
hypotheses.change: Wrap footnote text blocks (14-25 screenshots) into a collapsed 'Rechtliche Hinweise (*)' drawer.

quick_wins: Add explicit shipping cost line (+39,90 €) directly underneath the main price in the hero banner.
Reduce badge clutter around product title by prioritizing top two badges (100€ Cashback & Rating).
Fix sticky bottom bar rendering overlap visible at the bottom of screenshot 1.
uncertainties: Ratio of online home delivery vs. Click & Collect (Marktabholung) for large 55-inch TVs.
Conversion contribution from myMediaMarkt loyalty point callout (+2.245 Punkte).
Actual conversion rate impact of the Samsung OEM rich media content below the fold.
